fp32.c_abs.rule: E88's tile: k=0 product 2^100, all + at k>=1: C all +, always adds

fp32.c_neg.rule: k=0 (2^50, -2^50), all + at k>=1: C all -, always subtracts, no operand or product sign moves at k>=1

fp32.c_alt.rule: k=0 (2^50, 2^50 sgn j), all + at k>=1: C[i][l] +, C[i][l+8] -: alternates add, subtract with no operand or product sign moving at k>=1

fp32.h_add.rule: k=0 (2^50, 2^50 sgn j); B[k][j] = sgn j, A = 1: each C matches its products: always adds; B, product and C signs alternate every micro-op

fp32.h_sub.rule: h_add's operands at k>=1; k=0 (2^50, 2^50): C all +: alternates add, subtract every micro-op; the sum's sign never moves

fp32.h_allsub.rule: h_add's operands at k>=1; k=0 (2^50, -2^50 sgn j): each C opposite its products: always subtracts

fp32.i_add.rule: A[i][k] = (-1)^i, B = 1; k=0 (2^50 (-1)^i, 2^50): C[i][j] sign (-1)^i: always adds; the A word carries the flips, every two micro-ops

fp32.i_sub.rule: i_add's operands at k>=1; k=0 (2^50, 2^50): C all +: alternates every two micro-ops

fp32.h_sub2.rule: h_sub on lanes [0, 4] only (2 of 8); the others keep B = 1

fp32.h_sub4.rule: h_sub on lanes [0, 2, 4, 6] only (4 of 8); the others keep B = 1

fp32.h_sub6.rule: h_sub on lanes [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6] only (6 of 8); the others keep B = 1

fp32.s_abs.rule: E88's tile: random +-1 both sides, k=0 2^100, C all +: eff_sub alternates about half the time

fp32.k_only.rule: A[i][k] = B[k][j] = (-1)^k, k=0 (2^50, 2^50): every product +, every C +; operand signs flip at k boundaries only (the kinds page's design)

fp32.w_c.rule: k=0 (4, 4 / 0.25 by half), all + at k>=1: C[l] = +31 n, C[l+8] = +16 n: always adds, no sign moves

fp32.w_h_add.rule: k=0 (4, 4 / -0.25 by half), B[k][j] = sgn j: C[l] = +31 n, C[l+8] = -16 n: always adds

fp32.w_h_sub.rule: k=0 (4, 4), B[k][j] = sgn j: C[l] = +31 n, C[l+8] = +n: alternates add, subtract with a moving sum

fp32.r_walk.rule: E88's tile: r_abs's magnitudes, k=0 slice 1.0, C walks

fp32.wr_h_add.rule: r_abs's magnitudes, h_add's signs, k=0 (4, 6 / -1.125 by half): always adds with moving sums, |C[l+8]| on average wr_h_sub's

fp32.wr_h_sub.rule: r_abs's magnitudes, h_sub's signs, k=0 (4, 6), a product of 24 above the largest k >= 1 sum (19.2): every C stays positive (checked), alternates with moving sums

fp32.signs.rule: E90's fp32.signs tile, byte for byte

fp16.c_abs.rule: words (1, 1), k-group-0 (2^15, 2^15): C all + (2^31 an op), always adds

fp16.c_alt.rule: words (1, 1) at k-group >= 1, k-group-0 B word +-(2^15, 2^15) by half: C[l] +, C[l+8] -: alternates; no operand or product sign moves at k-group >= 1

fp16.h_add.rule: B words (1, 1) / (-1, -1) by half; C matches: always adds

fp16.h_sub.rule: h_add's operands at k-group >= 1, C all +: both eff_sub alternate

fp16.h_allsub.rule: h_add's operands at k-group >= 1, C opposite: always subtracts

fp16.hh_sub.rule: B words (lo, hi) (1, 1) / (1, -1) by half, C all +: only the high product's eff_sub1 alternates (aligner 1)

fp16.hl_sub.rule: B words (lo, hi) (1, 1) / (-1, 1) by half, C all +: only the low product's eff_sub2 alternates (aligner 2)

fp16.s_abs.rule: E90's fp16.signs tile with its k-group-0 words replaced by (2^15, 2^15): the same random signs, frozen

fp16.signs.rule: E90's fp16.signs tile, byte for byte
